blocks.x_article:
zm

I'm going to Singapore for the 13th World Zoroastrian Congress as a youth delegate. ZYAB Singapore selected me for a full subsidy to join their youth program at the Congress. It covers my hotel and registration and meals. It doesn't cover the flight.

The trip costs about $2200 and the flights are already bought. My family and I set aside $900 and I got $200 in support before opening this up. So I'm asking the community for $900 toward a $1000 goal. I'm seeding the first $100 on POIDH myself.

I need the support to be able to take a trip like this. I'm also excited to share more about this part of my life.

Send me a question about Zoroastrianism and I'll answer as many as I can on a YouTube livestream. Then I'll clip it into one edited video. If no questions come in I'll make one piece of content about Zoroastrianism and credit everyone who crowdfunded the trip.

Everything is on one page with a live total across every platform: [poidhz.com/singapore](https://poidhz.com/singapore)

I'll probably keep it open until after the Congress. While I'm there I'll share a short dispatch each day.

read the [web article]({edition}).
